title: Gentle Breeze Ballooning
specs: Flights launch at sunrise over desert scenery
Pilots are FAA-certified and experienced in desert weather
Post-flight champagne or sparkling cider toast tradition
Maximum weight 275 lbs per passenger; fees apply over 275 lbs

Expectant mothers not permitted to fly
No pets or service animals allowed
Gondolas not wheelchair accessible; no oxygen tanks, crutches, canes, or assistive devices
Shared flights hold 10-12 passengers depending on balloon

blurb: Guests check in at a Phoenix meeting point and are shuttled to the Casa Grande launch area. Flights last about 45 minutes, followed by a post-flight champagne or sparkling cider celebration. The experience includes balloon inflation, flight, landing, and return to the vehicle.
extraNote: 48-hour cancellation policy; no refunds if cancelled within 48 hours · Weather cancellations are fully refundable or reschedulable with no fees · No refund if late or missed flight; reschedule fee $50 per person · Guests must check in the day before for meeting times and flight info · Cannot wait for late arrivals; no rebooking for no-shows · 4005 E. Chandler Blvd, Phoenix, 85048
